detail.text:
Promotion `external-secrets.01abc.f08f1c9` ended errored and nothing has promoted this freight since. A terminal promotion is final: auto-promotion does not re-run one, because the freight has been promoted as far as the controller is concerned — the attempt merely failed. Every Application this Stage manages stays Synced and Healthy on the previous version, which is why nothing else reports it.

Why it ended: step "step-8": lookup api.github.com: server misbehaving

remedy.command:
# Re-run it. A Warehouse refresh will NOT: it re-discovers artifacts,
# and freight with a terminal promotion is never auto-promoted again.
kubectl create -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: kargo.akuity.io/v1alpha1
kind: Promotion
metadata:
  generateName: external-secrets          # no trailing dot: the webhook validates this as RFC1123
  namespace: addons
spec:
  stage: external-secrets
  freight: f08f1c9
EOF

summary.text: external-secrets stopped receiving artifacts 3d ago and will not retry on its own
